mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS visitId, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.fzjc, f.bqpg, f.zyzd, f.zlfa, f.blsj, p.name, p.gender, p.study_no AS studyNo, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.age, YEAR(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate)) AS createYear FROM patient_follow_up_history f JOIN patient_basic_info p ON p.id = f.patient_basic_info_id WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN #{id} AND f.research_type IN () AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), f.id

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, f.id AS visitId FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN #{id} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), f.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_application (doctor_id, doctor_name, start_date, end_date, scope, reason, mail_to, create_time) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{doctorName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{scope}, #{reason}, #{mailTo}, NOW())
